title: A separate inverse-second-moment argument certifies the explicit cat
statement: For r_i=sqrt(1+J_i^2),Delta_i=2r_i,delta=min Delta_i>2,t=sum r_i-(n+1),eta=product r_i^-1, retain the two conditional-product sectors and even cat c_+. The exact excitation law B=sum_i Delta_i xi_i uses independent xi_i~Bern(J_i^2/r_i^2),Pr(B=0)=eta^2. Define alpha=E[1_(B>0)/B],tau=E[1_(B>0)/B^2],kappa=E[1_(B>0)/(B-1)]. The producer gives t+eta+max(0,[alpha-(1+eta)tau]/[1+tau])<=lambda_max<=t+eta+kappa, kappa<=alpha+delta*tau/(delta-1), and SEPARATELY |<c_+|psi>|^2>=1/[1+tau/(1-1/delta)^2]. Exact spin-flip symmetry/positivity selects the even retained component; gap_even>=delta-1+eta>1 is earned, while a full target gap is neither assumed nor estimated. The fidelity claim is not inferred from energy width and is not robust to arbitrary symmetry breaking. Producer reports separate internal star/symmetry/preparation review; its body is not acquired here.
